name: sdlc
description: Universal SDLC orchestrator with stack provider auto-discovery. Owns the pipeline; framework plugins register themselves via stack.md profiles. Git-flow aware: detects the project's branching model and branch-naming convention, classifies the task type, proposes a branch, and targets the PR at the right base. Includes 5 cost-tiered default agents (BA Opus, Dev Sonnet, QA Sonnet with iteration cap, Sec Opus, Docs Haiku). Slash command: /sdlc:start "<feature>".

noninteractive.title: Non-interactive (headless) mode
noninteractive.description: Run /sdlc:start without interactive prompts (branch gate auto-resolves, policy failures become machine-readable output). The SDLC_NONINTERACTIVE environment variable, when set, wins over this option.

default_cost_cap_usd.title: Default cost cap (USD)
default_cost_cap_usd.description: Runaway guard applied to every run whose workflow recipe declares no caps.max_total_cost_usd. 0 disables it. The recipe value, when present, wins.

stack_cache_ttl_hours.title: Stack-detection cache TTL (hours)
stack_cache_ttl_hours.description: How long /sdlc:start trusts the SessionStart-hook stack-detection cache before re-scanning installed plugins. Lower it on machines where plugins change often.

post_check_fix_attempts.title: Post-pipeline check fix attempts
post_check_fix_attempts.description: When a post-pipeline check fails, dispatch the development architect for at most this many minimal-diff fix passes (0 = report only, 1 = one attempt). A project may override it in .claude/sdlc.local.yaml.
